Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-014 - Pagination clamps after result-set reduction

parameters.elementDescription: The medium-sized 'My Expenses' navigation link in the LEFT sidebar, directly below the selected 'Dashboard' link and above 'New Expense'; it opens the connected employee expense list.

parameters.script: return {href: location.href, pager: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b=>/page|next|previous/i.test((b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')+' '+(b.innerText||''))).map(b=>({text:b.innerText,aria:b.getAttribute('aria-label'),disabled:b.disabled})), footer: Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Showing[^\n]*|Page \d+ of \d+/g)).map(m=>m[0]), rows: document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length}

const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Next page' && !x.disabled); if(!b) return {clicked:false, reason:'enabled Next page not found'}; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); return {clicked:true, href:location.href, footer:Array.from(document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Showing[^\n]*|Page \d+ of \d+/g)).map(m=>m[0]), rows:document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length, firstRow:document.querySelector('tbody tr')?.innerText||'', pager:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(x=>/page/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')).map(x=>({aria:x.getAttribute('aria-label'),disabled:x.disabled}))};
